en.text: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我们当越发郑重所听见的道理，恐怕我们随流失去。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我們當越發鄭重所聽見的道理，恐怕我們隨流失去。

en.text: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

zhSimplified.text: 那借着天使所传的话既是确定的；凡干犯悖逆的都受了该受的报应。

zhTraditional.text: 那藉着天使所傳的話既是確定的；凡干犯悖逆的都受了該受的報應。

en.text: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

zhSimplified.text: 我们若忽略这么大的救恩，怎能逃罪呢？这救恩起先是主亲自讲的，后来是听见的人给我们证实了。

zhTraditional.text: 我們若忽略這麼大的救恩，怎能逃罪呢？這救恩起先是主親自講的，後來是聽見的人給我們證實了。

en.text: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

zhSimplified.text: 神又按自己的旨意，用神迹、奇事和百般的异能，并圣灵的恩赐，同他们作见证。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝又按自己的旨意，用神蹟、奇事和百般的異能，並聖靈的恩賜，同他們作見證。

en.text: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

zhSimplified.text: 我们所说将来的世界， 神原没有交给天使管辖。

zhTraditional.text: 我們所說將來的世界，上帝原沒有交給天使管轄。

en.text: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

zhSimplified.text: 但有人在经上某处证明说： 人算什么，你竟顾念他？ 世人算什么，你竟眷顾他？

zhTraditional.text: 但有人在經上某處證明說： 人算甚麼，你竟顧念他？ 世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他？

en.text: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

footnotes.text: 2:7 TR adds “and set him over the works of your hands”

zhSimplified.text: 你叫他比天使微小一点， 赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕， 并将你手所造的都派他管理，

footnotes.text: - 2:7 或译：你叫他暂时比天使小

zhTraditional.text: 你叫他比天使微小一點， 賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕， 並將你手所造的都派他管理，

footnotes.text: - 2:7 或譯：你叫他暫時比天使小

en.text: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

zhSimplified.text: 叫万物都服在他的脚下。

zhTraditional.text: 叫萬物都服在他的腳下。

en.text: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独见那成为比天使小一点的耶稣；因为受死的苦，就得了尊贵荣耀为冠冕，叫他因着 神的恩，为人人尝了死味。

footnotes.text: - 2:9 或译：惟独见耶稣暂时比天使小

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨見那成為比天使小一點的耶穌；因為受死的苦，就得了尊貴榮耀為冠冕，叫他因着上帝的恩，為人人嘗了死味。

footnotes.text: - 2:9 或譯：惟獨見耶穌暫時比天使小

en.text: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

zhSimplified.text: 原来那为万物所属、为万物所本的，要领许多的儿子进荣耀里去，使救他们的元帅，因受苦难得以完全，本是合宜的。

zhTraditional.text: 原來那為萬物所屬、為萬物所本的，要領許多的兒子進榮耀裏去，使救他們的元帥，因受苦難得以完全，本是合宜的。

en.text: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

footnotes.text: 2:11 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 因那使人成圣的和那些得以成圣的，都是出于一。所以，他称他们为弟兄也不以为耻，

zhTraditional.text: 因那使人成聖的和那些得以成聖的，都是出於一。所以，他稱他們為弟兄也不以為恥，

en.text: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

zhSimplified.text: 说： 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄， 在会中我要颂扬你；

zhTraditional.text: 說： 我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄， 在會中我要頌揚你；

en.text: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

zhSimplified.text: 又说： 我要倚赖他； 看哪，我与 神所给我的儿女。

zhTraditional.text: 又說： 我要倚賴他； 看哪，我與上帝所給我的兒女。

en.text: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

zhSimplified.text: 儿女既同有血肉之体，他也照样亲自成了血肉之体，特要借着死败坏那掌死权的，就是魔鬼，

zhTraditional.text: 兒女既同有血肉之體，他也照樣親自成了血肉之體，特要藉着死敗壞那掌死權的，就是魔鬼，

en.text: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

zhSimplified.text: 并要释放那些一生因怕死而为奴仆的人。

zhTraditional.text: 並要釋放那些一生因怕死而為奴僕的人。

en.text: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

zhSimplified.text: 他并不救拔天使，乃是救拔亚伯拉罕的后裔。

zhTraditional.text: 他並不救拔天使，乃是救拔亞伯拉罕的後裔。

en.text: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，他凡事该与他的弟兄相同，为要在 神的事上成为慈悲忠信的大祭司，为百姓的罪献上挽回祭。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，他凡事該與他的弟兄相同，為要在上帝的事上成為慈悲忠信的大祭司，為百姓的罪獻上挽回祭。

en.text: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

zhSimplified.text: 他自己既然被试探而受苦，就能搭救被试探的人。

zhTraditional.text: 他自己既然被試探而受苦，就能搭救被試探的人。
